adapters.acceptedShape: Constr 0 [Bound lower, Bound upper]; Bound = Constr 0 [Extended, Bool]; Extended tags 0 [], 1 [I time], 2 []
adapters.canonicalForm: Pinned re-encoding; infinite bounds always encode closure true
constraints: validTxRange adds non-emptiness but does not establish canonical encoding
discrepancies: Pinned decoder accepts false closure on infinite bounds and discards it

adapters.acceptedShape: Present = Constr 0 [I amount]; Absent = Constr 1 []; every other shape is Malformed
constraints: Malformed, Absent, and Present remain distinguishable
discrepancies: Pinned validTreasuryAmount decodes raw Integer and treats every decode failure as unspecified

adapters.acceptedShape: Present = Constr 0 [I amount]; Absent = Constr 1 []; every other shape is Malformed
constraints: Malformed, Absent, and Present remain distinguishable
discrepancies: Pinned validTreasuryDonation decodes raw Integer and treats every decode failure as unspecified

adapters.acceptedShape: Data.Map entries whose keys are Data.I; values stay opaque Data
adapters.canonicalForm: Separate nonempty strictly-ascending-unique key predicate; structural decode preserves order and duplicates
constraints: No parameter value enters the generic expression graph
Parameter IDs are not assigned semantic names by this adapter
discrepancies: Pinned proof model stores the complete payload as Data and only documents the map invariant

adapters.acceptedShape: Constr 0 [I numerator, I denominator] with nonzero denominator; decoded value is sign-normalized and reduced
adapters.canonicalForm: Positive coprime denominator after Plutus Rational re-encoding
constraints: Structural decode, canonical encoding, and Conway unit-interval validity are distinct
Unit interval additionally requires 0 <= numerator <= denominator and denominator > 0
discrepancies: Pinned proof model stores Quorum as raw Data and supplies no decoder or validity predicate
JuLC Rational currently decodes the pair structurally without enforcing or normalizing Plutus Rational invariants
